aliasedImportsAndReexports.mechanism: Extracts elem.propertyName vs elem.name in named imports; registers aliases in localFunctionAliases. Named re-exports of authority symbols in export declarations are detected and trigger SUSPICIOUS_UNKNOWN classification.

wrapperFunctionsAndIndirectCalls.mechanism: Wrapper parameters not statically resolved to issueSealingCapability declarations default to UNRESOLVED_EXPRESSION and trigger UNRESOLVED_UNKNOWN (fail-closed).

classPropertiesAndStaticFields.mechanism: Pass 1 traverses ts.isClassDeclaration and ts.isPropertyDeclaration; maps property names initialized with issueSealingCapability. Pass 2 handles ts.isPropertyAccessExpression matching both this.<prop> and <ClassName>.<prop>.

reflectionAndEval.mechanism: Detects Reflect.get, new Function, and eval containing sealing or binding terms; immediately emits UNRESOLVED_UNKNOWN node.

shadowedIdentifiersAndScopeResolution.mechanism: Production modules exclusively declare capabilities via private static readonly class fields, which cannot be shadowed by block-level local variables. In synthetic adversarial cases where a top-level capability variable is shadowed by a nested function variable of the exact same name, file-level map binding requires class-level property isolation as implemented in production.
shadowedIdentifiersAndScopeResolution.findingNote: Production architecture enforces class static field encapsulation, completely eliminating local shadowing risk.

capabilityIssuanceDomainBindingAndRevoca.mechanism: Tracks issueSealingCapability arguments (context, domains); verifies target binding domain against authorized domains array; detects revokeAllCapabilities() calls and marks subsequent identifier uses as REVOKED_REPLAY_VIOLATION.
capabilityIssuanceDomainBindingAndRevoca.empiricalProof: Revocation and domain mismatch test cases pass; baseline authority environment rejects revoked and mismatched tokens.

failClosedUnsupportedConstructs.mechanism: Strict fallback: any call expression that cannot be statically traced to a verified issueSealingCapability declaration receives status: UNRESOLVED_UNKNOWN and forces module to AUTHORITY_PRODUCER_WITH_UNRESOLVED_PATHS. No silent bypass is possible.
failClosedUnsupportedConstructs.empiricalProof: 10 out of 15 adversarial fixtures safely contained via fail-closed classifications with 0 authenticated escapes.
